text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening, Admire Groove's training had 
just finished, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Do your beeeest! Fu-ku-ki-ta-ru~~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ngoooo~! You're the one who needs to hang 
in there, Taiki-saaaan~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoooo! Nice one! Alright, let's keep 'em 
coming~~!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list:
Your classmate, right? They're working 
really hard.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Please head back first. I... will stay 
a bit longer."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I can't just give up and lose like this.
choice_data_list: Got it, you can go ahead!
Let's conserve our energy for tomorrow

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes... In that case, I will go run the 
outer perimeter.
choice_data_list: Aren't you doing it with your classmates?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have no intention of doing that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...More importantly, if we space out—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I've spotted Alv! Let's train 
togetheeer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Where are you going?! Wait for me, 
pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Deepening our bonds today is an auspicious 
sign! Come now, let's run together~!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ugh... honestly!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A game of tag, YOU SAY?! I WILL NOT 
LOSEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: !! They're actually here...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove kept running away from them, 
and in the end, it was practically a joint 
training session!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It seems no matter what I say, you 
won't listen.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I'll just do some 
stretching and head home.
choice_data_list: Why don't we ask those two to join us too?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Stretching with those two... there's no 
way this ends well...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm fine on my own.
